estimates.assumptions: Standard 1 tbsp Cajun spice mix ≈ 6 g (typical density for ground spices); used modest amount as it's a seasoning.
Typical white fish fillet (e.g. cod/haddock) ≈ 150 g each; assumed raw edible portion, common for pan-frying recipes.
Copying known value; standard 8-inch flour tortilla is ~40-50 g but using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
Medium avocado ≈ 150 g edible flesh when sliced (typical whole avocado 200-250 g minus skin/pit).
Little gem lettuce heads ≈ 100 g usable leaves each when shredded; typical value for lettuce.
Medium spring onion ≈ 15 g each; using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for raw/edible portion.
Jar is 300 ml; assumed ≈ 300 g for typical tomato-based salsa density.
Standard 'pot' of sour cream ≈ 200 g (common supermarket size ~150-250 ml).
Medium lemon ≈ 100 g whole (edible zest/juice portion; using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for whole fruit).
